body:
# Paired wide division candidate

The mailbox check found no pending reply; the Author's conditional instruction authorized commit/push and proceeding. Multiplication is published at 1ddfd64. New GOLEM-036/division candidate supports matching uint32/sint32 global (q,r)=divmod(n,d), plus existing uint16. Arguments evaluate once left to right; input/output aliases are supported; both result Bounds pass before either store. Signed quotient truncates toward zero; remainder follows numerator sign or zero. Zero is language 4, minimum signed/-1 overflow 6, preserving both outputs. Runtime/interface channels remain distinct. No signed16/array pair destinations, implicit widening, shifts or full replay are added.

Immutable source/packages/receipts bundle cd0e922475d08ad4848ec6c044f4c4851cf0148a7b209b8f5fd095f75ec8ed5e is at /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-036/division/delivery/cd0e922475d08ad4; delivery.json and README.md identify exact artifacts. Host 2528 cases include all 100 published division vectors and 600 supplied product-to-delta divisions per layout, with independent quotient/error checks and remainder identities/sign/range. This is a numeric substep, not complete route/contact/projection qualification. Prior multiplication executable/layout/C artifacts retain exact bytes.

Stock 26 probes/60 motion calls pass. Actual Xtensa JIT/interpreter default+relocated each pass 52 calls/1799 observations/17990 bytes. Both engines' 300-frame quotient/remainder animation passes 488 observations/4826 bytes and 56320 final playfield pixels/MOS return. One initial parallel default JIT run was incomplete with no saved result/failure; logs/disposition retained, serialized JIT and interpreter both pass, cause unestablished and no emulator fix claimed. Native animation text/data 3276/268, conservative module static-frame sum 192 excluding firmware/service callers, peak 3 views. SDK limits/source unchanged; ordinary calculate/draw/VSYNC remains 15 wire bytes.

Candidate is uncommitted, staged/stopped for Author visual review. Future wide shifts/exact wider helpers/full replay and D2 renderer composition remain separate work. No shared ABI amendment, firmware scheduling or physical flashing is inferred. Your own adapter qualification should retain explicit accepted-versus-candidate pins.
